[LGRA.2.8.10] A `time_expr` position ([LGRA.2.8.1]) takes a bare `UNIT_LIT` or
a `NAME` and admits no sign, so the compiler must refuse `within -5_s` and
`scope ttl -5_s` at parse. A rate modifier's sign has its own code instead
([LGRA.6.6.7]). In an expression position `-5_s` parses, as unary minus through the
`unary` production of [LGRA.9.5.1], and the compiler refuses it: a `Duration`
is never negative ([LUNI.3.3]). A "no value" opt-out uses a dedicated flag
(`nocooldown`), not a duration.
